parts.watchFor: Watch how Idris's light stays steady when the lamps around him flicker.

questions.q: What did Shith do for the children of Adam by the river?
What do many scholars relate Idris was among the first to do?
What did Idris do when most people walked past or mocked him?
options: He kept calling, season after season, with patience

lesson.text: Idris was a man of truth who kept calling people to God with patience, and God raised him to a high station. Steady, truthful effort is never lost with God.
lesson.curious: Muslims honour Idris, often identified with the biblical Enoch, as a truthful prophet who kept calling people to God patiently, and was raised to a high station.

reflect.muslim: Which good habit do you keep only when people are watching? How could you make it steady?
reflect.curious: What does it take to keep doing something right when most people ignore it?

parts.act: Keep one good habit going all week, even when no one notices.

parts.watchFor: Watch how a good intention turns into something wrong, one generation at a time.

questions.q: Why did the people first carve the five statues?
What happened to the statues as generations passed?
options: The reason was forgotten and they were worshipped
They were moved to the hills

questions.q: Who stood apart on a hill and watched?

lesson.text: The statues began as a way to remember good men. Generations later, people worshipped them. Small steps away from worshipping God alone can look harmless at first, so guard what you give your heart to.
lesson.curious: Muslims see in this story how honouring good people can, over generations, slide into worshipping them, and why Islam keeps worship for God alone.

carry.title: Ibrahim's prayer to be kept from idols

reflect.muslim: Is there anything you give so much of your heart to that it competes with God?
reflect.curious: Can you think of a tradition whose original reason has been forgotten? What took its place?

parts.act: When you remember someone good, pray for them, rather than only praising them.
